findings.title: Chainalysis Security Incident Information
findings.summary_md: Chainalysis published its vendor advisory on October 30, 2026, describing an external actor that used 'offensive agentic techniques' to access internal systems and tools. The company confirmed that customer names, email addresses, user IDs, and organizational role labels were accessed, but stated there was no evidence that authentication credentials, session tokens, or investigation content were exposed. Chainalysis said it had been patching vulnerabilities and hardening systems since detection.
